problems: The swallow itself cannot be seen: in storyboard frames 1-3 a small figure stands by the cattails, a yellow bird pops up, and one frame later there is already a big green ball. No contact or 'hit' happens before it, and nothing gets taken in.

Pinchy can barely be seen inside the jelly for most of the film. In frames 4-14 and in the 50% and 75% stills the ball shows mostly the bird; the crab is only a few orange bits of claw at the edge and is not readable as a second creature being held inside.
The caption says Pinchy 'said it was squishy in there', but no speech, bubble or text appears in any frame.

The 'hiccup' is not shown: between frames 14 and 15 the crab simply appears outside next to the bird, wearing a party hat, with no ejection, no movement out of the ball and no reaction from the bird. By frame 16 it is lying in front of the bird without having been seen to fly or land.

'I went jelly' reads as a big glass ball forming around the bird, not as the bird turning into jelly. Through most of the film (frames 4-14) the ball just sits there and drifts slightly, and nothing happens for about 7 seconds.

The foreground cattails cut across the lower half of the ball in every middle frame (25%, 50% and 75% stills) and hide the bottom of the action. Most of the picture is taken up by scenery and the empty signboard.
Orange dots float in the air left of the ball in frames 8-12 and in the 50% still, with no visible source or cause.
posts.critique: A green ball with a bird inside sits behind cattails for most of the clip, and the two moments the caption is about, the swallow and the hiccup, both happen between frames. Pinchy's 'squishy' line never appears on screen. A viewer sees a bubble, not a crab being eaten and spat out.
